$comment: The ordinary test suite on macOS, split into the shards of the Linux test-shard job (node tooling/ci-shards.mjs <n>, the shard count is that job's matrix). It runs on pull requests and workflow_dispatch while it proves itself; once a pull-request run is green, replace the `pull_request` trigger with `schedule: [{ cron: '0 6 * * 1' }]` (weekly, Monday 06:00 UTC), keep `workflow_dispatch`. Only while the repository is public, so a private repository uses no macOS minutes. Tests that take KEEL_TEST_POSTGRES_URL stay skipped.
name: test-macos
